name: Frigidaire Gallery® 24" Smudge-Proof™ Stainless Steel Top Control Built-In Dishwasher
shortDescription: Frigidaire Gallery 24" Stainless Steel Tub Built-In Dishwasher with CleanBoost™ Technology maximizes the power of your detergent by premixing water and detergent before it hits your dishes, helping remove hard-to-clean and baked-on foods.

features.text: Offers enhanced drying results with MaxBoost™ Dry. This quiet dishwasher (47 dBA) also offers a sanitize option, an adjustable rack, LED floor indicator light, 30-minute quick wash, and is Energy Star® certified.
Get better cleaning results with CleanBoost™ technology
Our patented CleanBoost™ Technology premixes water and detergent, dissolving detergent 6x faster helping to remove hard-to-clean and baked-on foods.
Sanitize Option
Remove 99.9% of common household bacteria with NSF-Certified Sanitize Option.
Enhanced drying results with MaxBoost Dry™
MaxBoost Dry™ technology uses heat and a fan to direct moisture out and pull in fresh air that dries your dishes.
Saves over 4000 gallons of water every year
By avoiding hand washing and putting your dishes straight in the dishwasher, not only will you get great cleaning results, you can save over 4000 gallons of water per year.
DishSense® Sensor Technology
Skip pre-rinsing with our DishSense® sensor technology that adjusts cleaning performance based on the soil level of your dishes.
Complete clean from every angle with OrbitClean®
OrbitClean® wash system uses a rotating wash arm with multi-directional spray patterns to provide maximum coverage without using more water.
ENERGY STAR® Certified
Maximize your water, energy and dollar savings with ENERGY STAR® Certified appliances.
Premium Capacitive Touch User Interface
Our sleek designed capacitive multi-touch user interface is intuitive and helps you to easily select the right program for your dishes.
Easily fits dishes of all sizes with an adjustable rack
Make loading the dishwasher easier with an adjustable rack and enough space to fit large items.
Smudge-Proof™ Stainless Steel
Resists fingerprints and cleans easily.
Cleans Hard-to-Reach Spots
Clean hard-to-reach spots with our Target Spray Zones that target tough spots for the ultimate clean.
Powerful 30-Minute Clean
Get a powerful clean, fast in just 30 minutes.
Keep your kitchen quiet with 47 dBA
Keep your kitchen quiet and the noise inside your dishwasher where it belongs with extra, quality insulation.
Third Level Rack
Save time loading and unloading with a third level rack that easily fits silverware, cooking utensils and tools.
Convenient status indicator floor light
Convenient LED floor light shows cycle status- blue when your dishes are washing and green when they are clean.
Protecting your floors against water leaks
In the event of a leak a sensor is triggered stopping the cycle and containing overflowed water in a tray at the bottom of the dishwasher.
